notes.title: Annie and the AI wins 4 NYX Game Awards!
notes.notes:
From NYX Game Awards:

Dear NoSleepGames,
We are elated to inform you that your amazing game has proven itself to be a superlative symbol within the entirety of the gaming industry and community.

After conducting a thorough evaluation of your game, we have determined it to be the epitome of its own level, as your impeccable presentations of gaming are everlastingly outstanding in every aspect. Therefore, we are pleased to announce, in accordance with our professional evaluations, you have been crowned as a 2023 NYX Game Awards Gold winner within the PC Game - Best Storytelling category, Gold winner within the PC Game - Best narrative category, Silver winner within the PC Game - Best Performance category, Silver winner within the PC Game - Best Music category.


On behalf of the NYX Game Awards committee and organization, please accept our bona fide commendations upon your brilliant achievement, enabling your efforts to be internationally celebrated and recognized. We wish that your career continues to flourish within the industry and eventually conquer greater heights in the near future. With that, we would like to thank you for your participation in the NYX awards and we hope to see more of your exquisite entries amongst the masses, in our next cycle!

notes.title: Annie and the AI was chosen to participate in the Tiny Teams festival!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101952/04b86744c55fe6e1f647a4e7e627fecb58424a34.png[/img]
Tiny teams is all about finding micro studios with massive ideas. We are honored to be part of this event and to offer our largest discount to date. This is a great time to pick up a copy of Annie and the AI. And be sure to check out all the other amazing games made by small studios like ours:
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival2023
